name: knowledge-observatory.prepare-change
purpose: Prepare documentation maintenance: cleanup, consolidation, reorganization and artifact promotion with source dispositions, preservation obligations, revision preconditions and a scoped reference baseline.
assumptions: Source owners retain knowledge authority; no search score establishes acceptance.
Knowledge Observatory and declared read dependencies are running.
invariants: One bounded envelope on every path; no writes, retries, or shell access.
Unknown applicability and unavailable reads remain explicit.
The caller owns final task verification and one learning capture; no memory writes inside these programs.

signals.preconditions: Exact source byte hashes; recheck before caller writes.
signals.observations: At most 100 backlink, duplicate, missing-reference, or portability cues.
signals.decisions_required: Editorial decisions; never an automatic deletion instruction.
signals.editorial_review_complete: Caller-supplied editorial review status; never proof of task completion.
signals.dispositions: Selected source/action/targets/reason/preserve/decision/evidence_refs with observed source hashes; missing decisions remain unresolved.
signals.reference_baseline: Complete bounded owner findings and exact selectors for before/after comparison.

outputs.evidence: Repository-relative paths and source revisions or owner run IDs; no private corpus dump.

inputs.intent: documentation maintenance consolidation preserve task knowledge
